title: plugin-auth: the showcase dev platform admin gets 403 YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_DELETE_USERS on POST /api/v1/auth/admin/remove-user
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #29062 dev (os-dev-report 6574609406, `out_of_scope_findings` class a; measured by the earlier #29062 card thread, report 6571331581). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 · the dev admin cannot exercise a documented admin door; no grant or disclosure.

Reach: public door `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/remove-user`, called by the dev-seeded platform admin on a fresh showcase boot.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth`, the dev-admin seed or the admin-plugin role mapping).

## What happens (measured by the #29062 card thread on a fresh showcase boot at `6b3ba82c`, not re-measured on this card)

- Signed in as the showcase's dev platform admin, `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/remove-user {"userId": …}` answers 403 `YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_DELETE_USERS`.
- The dev's reading: the vendor admin plugin checks the user's `role` scalar, and the seeded admin's scalar is not `admin`, even though ObjectStack treats the account as platform admin.

## Wanted

Measure on `main` first. If the seeded platform admin is meant to hold the vendor admin role, seed or map it so the admin plugin's own checks agree with ObjectStack's platform-admin reading; if not, say which account the docs mean for admin user removal. Check the other `/auth/admin/*` doors for the same split.

Dedupe: searched `remove-user 403 admin`, `platform admin better-auth role scalar`; none. **New.**

Links back: #29062, PR #29245.
